statement: The closest work evaluates with structured multiple-choice items generated over its own disease-specific KG/CG datasets across 1-5 hops, and reports robustness to option shuffling with an average absolute accuracy change below one percentage point.

evidence.quote: We construct disease-specific Gastroparesis and Diabetes KG/CG datasets and generate structured multiple-choice QA items spanning 1-hop to 5-hop reasoning, grounded entirely in verifiable KG/CG paths.
